test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The farmers used to ______ seeds by this time.
solution:
The correct answer is **"sow."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Sow"** means to plant seeds in the ground. (ज़मीन में बीज बोना, पौधा रोपना)

 
 
• **Example**: *I was asked to **sow**__ seeds in the pot.*
 
 
 
• It is the correct word to use in this context as the farmers are planting seeds.
 
• The past tense of** "sow" is "sowed" or "sown".**

The correct answer is **Option 3.**

**Correct sentence**: *The farmers used to __**sow**__ seeds by this time. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 - "soe"** is not a word in the English language.
 
• **Option 2 - "sew"** means to join two pieces of fabric together with a needle and thread. ((कपड़ों को या कपड़ों के साथ किसी वस्‍तु को) सीना (सूई और धागे के साथ टाँके मारते हुए))
 
• **Option 4 - "so"** is an adverb not a verb and does not make sense in this context. It means used to emphasize an adjective or adverb, especially when this produces a particular result. (किसी विशेषण या क्रियाविशेषण पर बल देने के लिए प्रयुक्त (विशेषतः जब विशिष्‍ट प्रतिक्रिया का निर्देश करना हो), इतना, बहुत)

1a3:T965,

The correct answer is **"sow."**
